highlights: We will begin the call with opening remarks from the management, following which we will have the forum open for a
Consolidated sales volume revenue grew 28.7% with a volume growth of 22.5% in India and 39.9% in international markets.
In line with our dividend policy, the Board of Directors have approved an interim dividend of 25% of the face value, Rs. 0.50 per share, resulting in total cash outflow of Rs. 1,691 million.
Growth during the quarter was primarily driven by a 28.7% increase in consolidated sales volume to the level of 354.4 million cases in India.
Volume grew by a strong 22.5% during the quarter, while international territories recorded robust growth of 39.9%.
